label: Before repairs
prompt:

Bright cartoon colour, no gritty photorealism, no gloomy brown wash. Portrait 9:16, fixed camera, readable repair subjects, no UI or typography.

No collage or cutaway panels. Main room occupies central 75%, a quiet foreground floor or path occupies lower 20%, architecture visible above. Clear 3D depth, soft shadows and ambient occlusion; materials are smooth but detailed, not plastic toys. The space needs repair but is still cheerful, sunlit, colourful and inviting.
